subject: Novus Exec Workshop — arrival windows, staff rotation & backup routing

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novus Exec Workshop — arrival windows, staff rotation & backup routing

Hi Aditi / Scheduling team,

Thanks again for the quick sync today. To keep momentum on logistics, we want to lock in arrival windows and a staff rotation plan so the on-the-ground team has clear handover times (and we can publish hotel blocks). Proposed primary onsite dates:

- Workshop days: Mon Sept 20 — Wed Sept 22 (onsite in Singapore)
- Preferred arrival window for Novus execs: Sun Sept 19 (afternoon) — Mon Sept 20 (AM)

A few asks from our side so we can finalize staffing:
- Confirm final attendee headcount and names (execs + observers).
- Any passport/visa needs for Singapore? If you share names we can provide invitation letters.
- Would you like airport pickup for the delegation? If yes, please flag flight ETAs and airlines.
- Any hotel preference? We usually suggest Four Seasons (closer to venue) or Grand Hyatt (better corporate rate).

Operational notes we plan to follow: split our SEs into overlapping shifts so there is always a Red-hooded lead on site during core hours, with a twilight handoff for late arrivals. We will also provision a virtual bridge for APAC/EU folks on Day 1 if travel is delayed.

I can share a preliminary agenda and a proposed rotation matrix — attaching the current agenda (v2). Can you confirm by EOD Friday (Aug 13) so Marissa can begin bookings?

Thanks — looking forward.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear plan. A few updates from our side:

- Confirmed headcount: 6 execs + 2 observers (total 8). Names attached in attendee_contacts.csv.
- APAC execs prefer to join virtually for Day 1 (travel conflicts). They will be physically present for Days 2–3.
- We do need invitation letters for two senior execs (passport numbers supplied in the attachment). Can Redwood issue the standard visa invitation?
- Airport pickup: Yes for two VIPs arriving on Sept 19 at 15:40 (SQ321) and Sept 20 at 07:15 (QF45).
- Hotel: prefer Four Seasons if the corporate rate is close — otherwise Grand Hyatt is fine.

Also: can you confirm rehearsal / tech-check window on Sun Sept 19 between 16:00–18:00? Our AV lead will attend.

Attaching: attendee_contacts.csv (names + passport partials).

Best,

Subject: INTERNAL: Novus logistics draft — staff rotation & hotel asks

Team — forwarding Novus preferences and a shortlist of operational items I want us to own. Key points:

1) Staff rotation (proposed):
   - Shift A (lead + 2 SEs): Sept 19 — Sept 23 (arrive Sept 18 evening if possible)
   - Shift B (lead + 2 SEs): Sept 22 — Sept 26 (overlap on Sept 22 for knowledge transfer)
   - On-call rotation: 17:00—20:00 local each day (for late exec sessions)

2) Hotels: please price Four Seasons + Grand Hyatt corporate rate and include early check-in on Sept 19. Prefer Four Seasons for exec-facing leads.

3) AV/venue: Monica, confirm rehearsal slot Sun Sept 19 16:00–18:00 and a simple backup feed (Zoom + local codec). We need attendee mic counts and two roaming lapel mics.

4) Visa letter: I will send a templated invitation once Novus confirms passports. Marissa — can you own sending the invitation letters and collecting passport scans? Need them by Aug 25 to meet visa processing SLA.

5) Travel buys: Marissa, please start holding refundable fares for the Shift A team for arrivals Sept 18–19 and Shift B for Sept 22–23. Keep costs tight but favor refundable on key legs.

Attaching agenda (v2) for context. Priyom — once you have flight lane options, drop the CSV in the thread and I will review.

Thanks,
Sergio

Sergio — attaching the preliminary flight lanes and rotation CSV (staff_rotation_flights.csv). Notes below: 

- Best inbound windows to hit Sept 19 rehearsal: SFO->SIN red-eye (depart Sept 18 23:30, arrive Sept 19 06:25) and LHR->SIN overnight (depart Sept 18 21:15, arrive Sept 19 15:30).
- Shift overlap day (Sept 22): plan a 90-minute handover at 09:00 local, followed by a 30-minute tech check at 11:00.
- Fallback: EU participants can join via our Singapore bridge with local codec; we will publish dial-in + local PST/CEST/SGT times.
- Hotel recommendation: Four Seasons corporate rate is ~8% higher but saves 25 minutes of transfer time to venue. I recommend booking 4 rooms there for leads and rest at Grand Hyatt to control budget.
